# Data quality — NSXUSD

Source wall times use the New York clock, but the DST switch dates follow the EU calendar (last Sunday in March/October). Relative to a New York-zone conversion, +60 minutes is applied in the U.S./EU transition windows. Ambiguous fall-back rows use chronological fold order; nonexistent spring-forward rows are dropped and counted below. HistData volume is unavailable and stored as NaN; no volume-dependent features should use it.
